comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Truckload carrier hauling freight for shippers; not a railcar manufacturer, so a different business model and customers.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Intermodal and trucking logistics service provider, not a railcar builder; it buys transport capacity rather than manufacturing equipment.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Makes rail track components, coatings and concrete for infrastructure; it does not build freight railcars or lease them.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Car-hauler trucking service for finished vehicles; a trucking carrier, not a railcar maker.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Builds freight railcars (hoppers, gondolas), leases railcars and does repair and parts for railroads, lessors and shippers.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: LTL trucking network operator; a freight service business, not railcar manufacturing or leasing.
